podcast.body: This self-titled debut album, released in 1996, featured an alt-rock radio hit and was characterized by its self-referential and mundane subject matter. The band's name itself, taken from a Star Wars quote, cemented their geek rock identity. "This was an alt-rock radio hit from 1996, and it was from their self-titled debut album."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This self-titled debut album, released in 1996, featured the alt-rock radio hit "Van Halen." It was released by the band that explicitly branded itself as "Geek Rock." "This was an all-rock radio hit from 1996, and it was from their self-titled debut album."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
